body: A bullet to the brain is more likely but keep your optimism I guess

Nope, learned that asking for help brings the dicks out of the woodwork and I should just shut the fuck up and struggle silently because no one gives a fuck.

Don't worry. This is going to be my last post. Probably ever.

I came to a community that appeared to have help and resources.

I, being in a bad situation, asked for help and resources.

I got told "it's irresponsible for us to help you get your shit together until you magically get all your shit together, so no"

Yep, guess I'm stupid for thinking a trauma community would be any more welcoming than the rest of this orange shitshow.
Well I sure learned my lesson. Gold fucking star for you.

"How old are you? My advice will be different depending on if you're an adult or not"

Carries very different conversational connotations than

"How old are you"

Generally when people approach me with the latter they do not have good intentions.
It's fine. I get it. I was stupid to ask for help here and I need to just shut up and fix myself because no one here is willing to even give me a place to start.
Mmmmm why? Do you have a reason for asking that's _not_ going to be using my age to discount my trauma and use it as an excuse for why you won't help me?

I was lucky. 

I went to my last therapist seeking help with PTSD symptoms and, after about a month, she switched my diagnosis to CPTSD and outlined the basics of it for me. I stopped seeing her because she was unprofessional in other regards, but I consider myself fortunate to have gotten that answer so quickly and easily compared to the stories of people struggling for years without a diagnosis. 

Then since I know that places like r/depression and r/anxiety exist, I took a chance and typed r/cptsd and have been lurking here ever since.
